text: 二十国集团（G20）在泰国曼谷召开今年第三次G20财长和央行行长会议。会议讨论了全球经济形势与展望、金融部门改革等议题。中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席会议并发言，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能参加会议。 潘功胜指出，地缘政治冲突加剧仍是全球经济的最大不确定性。一些国家国债市场大幅波动、人工智能相关资产估值回调风险加剧了金融脆弱性。促进金融监管现代化不等于放松监管，不应损害金融体系稳定和风险抵御水平。各方应充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。关于全球失衡，各方应有更全面的分析视角。不能只看经常账户，也要关注金融渠道，特别是随着全
text_en: The G20 held its third G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of the year in Bangkok, Thailand. The meeting discussed the global economic situation and outlook, financial sector reform, and other topics. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended the meeting and delivered remarks, and PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng also attended. Pan Gongsheng pointed out that intensifying geopolitical conflicts remain the biggest uncertainty for the global economy. Sharp fluctuations in some countries' government bond markets and rising risk of valuation corrections in AI-related assets have exacerbated financial fragility. Modernizing financial regulation does not mean loosening regulation, and it should not undermine the stability of the financial system and its capacity to withstand risks. All parties should make full use of the G20 finance and financial cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and work together to address global risks and challenges. On global imbalances, all parties should adopt a more comprehensive analytical perspective.
